NEGOTIATED.src: LM_HG201 National Daily Direct Hog Prior Day report published 2026-11-19, covering the Wednesday 2026-11-18 slaughter. Read from the PRIMARY source: the USDA AMS 'National Daily Hog and Pork Summary' PDF printing 'Nov 19, 2026 ... Des Moines, Iowa Thu' (AMS 2511/LM_HG201 block), via the Barchart S3 mirror of the AMS file. This settles the figure that last session's run could not corroborate: an aggregator had rendered this same report with a national change of -0.81, which the primary document contradicts (producer base moved 61.12 -> 60.04, i.e. -1.08). The aggregator was wrong and has been discarded. The 2026-11-20-published prior-day report (2026-11-19 slaughter) could NOT be obtained: the AMS mnreports ams_2511.pdf endpoint was serving a STALE file printed 'October 23, 2026' covering the 2026-10-22 slaughter, and the correctly-dated 2026-11-20 mirror was not retrievable this session. Nothing was carried forward under today's date. Negotiated base 36.70 on 2,863 head; net 36.34. roll5 is the mean of the five most recent PUBLISHED negotiated base prices held here (Nov 9 49.43, Nov 10 43.25, Nov 16 40.04, Nov 17 38.75, Nov 18 36.70 = 41.63); Nov 11-13 were never captured by earlier runs, so this spans Nov 9-18 rather than five consecutive sessions. IMPORTANT CAVEAT: low/high are NOT 2026-11-18 figures. The Nov 19 summary document does not print LM_HG201's Lowest/Highest Net Lot, so the 34.70/44.00 range shown is still the 2026-11-17 dispersion and should be read as such. Reported but deliberately excluded from PI.

CUTOUT.src: LM_PK602 afternoon (FOB plant), 2026-11-19 PM: cutout 68.66, -0.82 from 69.48. Read from the PRIMARY source - the USDA AMS 'National Daily Hog and Pork Summary' PDF whose own printed header reads 'Nov 19, 2026 ... Des Moines, Iowa Thu' (retrieved from the Barchart S3 mirror of the AMS file, which serves the correctly-dated document, NOT the mnreports endpoint). Corroborated arithmetically: all SIX primals chain exactly off the independently confirmed 2026-11-18 values held here - Loin 68.40-2.17=66.23, Butt 97.19-1.22=95.97, Picnic 56.99+0.46=57.45, Rib 127.58+0.82=128.40, Ham 62.90-0.14=62.76, Belly 66.48-1.13=65.35 - and the cutout itself chains 69.48-0.82=68.66. Six-for-six primal reconciliation plus the headline chain is stronger corroboration than a second aggregator rendering. Total loads 239.20 (pork cuts 208.84 + trim/process 30.36). The 2026-11-20 PM cutout could NOT be obtained: the AMS mnreports endpoints were re-checked this session and were again serving STALE files - ams_2498.pdf printed 'October 26, 2026' and lsddhps.pdf printed 'Oct 23, 2026' - and no wire covering the 2026-11-20 afternoon report had published by run time (ThePigSite's latest CME wire is dated 2026-11-19 and covers Wednesday 2026-11-18). Value and asof are therefore held at 2026-11-19 rather than carried forward with today's date.

Two independent arithmetic checks support it: it chains exactly to the 332.30 held for 2026-11-19, and the article's "for the week up $11.20" reconciles against the 329.80 held for Nov 13.
